# ankra_cluster_dns_zones (Data Source)

Lists the generated DNS domains (the per-cluster zone under the organisation's root domain) of the clusters in the provider's scope, with their reconciliation state. When the provider sets `project_id`, only that project's clusters are listed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster_dns_zones" "all" {}

output "cluster_domains" {
  value = { for zone in data.ankra_cluster_dns_zones.all.zones : zone.cluster_name => zone.fqdn }
}

output "failing_cluster_domains" {
  value = [for zone in data.ankra_cluster_dns_zones.all.zones : zone.cluster_name if zone.last_error != null]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `zones` (Attributes List) Cluster DNS domains. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the domain belongs to.
- `cluster_name` (String) Cluster name.
- `fqdn` (String) The cluster's domain.
- `last_error` (String) Last reconciliation error, if any.
- `state` (String) Reconciliation state, such as `active` or `pending`.
